record.question: You are the Superintendent of Police (Traffic). It has come to your notice that some traffic policemen are in the habit of being late, being intoxicated while on duty and unnecessarily demanding fines. Draft a memorandum to be circulated among the force to erase these irregularities and announcing that strict disciplinary measures would be meted out to those who do not comply.
